title: SOLARBABY Solar Crank Radio — AM/FM, Flashlight & Power Bank
short_description: Emergency radio with three charging options: solar panel, hand crank or USB. With AM/FM reception, LED flashlight and a 2000 mAh battery to top up your phone in an emergency — for camping and emergency kits.
long_description: The SOLARBABY emergency radio (part number 8795643) receives AM and FM and has a 3-watt speaker. It charges via the built-in solar panel, the hand crank (dynamo) or a USB cable – so it stays usable even without a power outlet. An integrated LED flashlight provides light, and the 2000 mAh battery can top up a phone via USB in an emergency. According to the manufacturer, the device is water-resistant. A micro USB cable and instructions are included. Practical for camping, outdoor trips and as part of a home emergency kit.
buying_angle: Practical for campers and anyone who needs a radio with light for power cuts or emergencies that works without a power outlet.
